Name: Font Settings Button Lynnea's Witchy Purple UI Recolor
Author: moodolive
Description:
[size=4]This mod is a recolor of the font settings button added to the title screen by the Font Settings mod. It is so that, if you have Font Settings and are playing with Lynnea's Witchy and Purple UI overlay, your Font Settings button will match Lynnea's aesthetic.[/size]

[size=3]Required Mods:
[/size]- [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24693]Lynnea's Witchy and Purple UI Overlay[/url]﻿
- [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url]

[size=3]Instructions:

[/size]1. Go to your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder 
2. Find the "Font Settings" folder
3. Go to "assets"
4. replace the old "font-button.png" file with the file of the same name that you downloaded from me.
5. Play the game, and the button should match the rest of the UI!


[i]Please let me know if you have any issues with this mod or suggest a different icon for a different language!
[/i]
